main_topics.reason: The user opened by asking whether a drop from 20 to 15 migraine days counts as the treatment working, and the whole conversation revolves around this.
The user logs days in an app and asks what to track until the six-month point, over several turns.
The user asked what to raise with their neurologist and worried the drug might be stopped.
The user realised their attacks were less severe, discussed briefly in one exchange.
The user said they wanted to feel encouraged and were disappointed at about 25% reduction, then felt better.

output.summary: A user three months into Emgality asked whether a drop from 20 to 15 migraine days counted as it working. The bot explained the 50% benchmark, that response can keep building to six months, and that severity also matters, and suggested what to bring to the neurologist. The user said they felt much better and reframed the treatment as working but not finished.
